text:
Noah: Heads-up: 22 bus rerouted around 3rd & Pine due to flooded underpass. Expect 2030m delay if you're on the northbound. Shoes are a mess.
Jin: Thanks Noah. Does anyone know if the shuttle is still running from Market?
Renee: Shuttle is running but it's slower than a snail with a latte. I had to take a detour through the back alleys. :grimacing:
Omar: If youre coming downtown, I have a couple of plastic grocery bags in my drawer for soggy shoes. Come grab.
commute-bot: [alert] SF Muni 22 detour due to water over roadway at 3rd & Pine. Crews responding. Updates will follow.
Noah: Poll: should we set up a permanent "commute kit" shelf by the mailroom? Reply yes/no.
Jin: yes -> especially if rain season is back.
Renee: yes +1. Also towels? tiny towel rack would be wild.
Omar: no if it becomes the office lost-and-found for ten thousand umbrellas. 
Facilities: Janitorial can add a small bin and drying rack for a trial week. Were on it.
Noah: Also, PSA: the 3rd & Pine underpass has a new pothole filled with a small lake. Avoid the right lane.
Jin: LOL the pothole is now "Lake Tiny Tim". Someone should put a canoe emoji on the map. :canoe:
Renee: Offer: Ill buy coffee for the soggy-commuters meetup at 10:30 in the lobby. Who's in?
Omar: In. I will bring paper towels.
commute-bot: [update] Muni reports partial service restoration on 22. Expect residual delays ~10m.
Noah: Thanks folks. Meetup in lobby, coffee, and someone take a GIF of the epic shoe pile for posterity.
Jin: On it. Also reminding everyone: if you borrow anything, tag the owner or leave a note. :memo:
